brandkit-setup.gate: required capabilities have observed evidence or accepted fallback

brandkit-interview.gate: required axes are sourced, explicitly open, or not applicable and no normative conflict remains

brandkit-build.gate: package validates and every normative value has provenance

brandkit-publish.gate: brand, facts, rights, contracts, renderer and visual review pass with no open-work marker

brandkit-spacing.gate: one pinned brand and one medium namespace resolve; every inventory entry maps to exactly one token or evidenced exception

legal_policy.accepted_basis: official source supplied by the user

humanizer_policy.scope: mutable single-line prose segments from the markdown contract
humanizer_policy.passes: Pass 0 triage; Pass 1 evidence/artifacts; confirmed-cluster Passes 2-4; Pass 5 self-audit
humanizer_policy.old_hash_semantics: validates the addressed baseline segment; replacement bytes may and normally do hash differently
humanizer_policy.pattern_catalog_contract: pinned references/patterns.md revision/hash plus the exact canonical ids 1..72; aliases, duplicates and malformed or unknown ids fail
humanizer_policy.model_call_contract: Claude Code 2.1.223 only: closed full raw result envelope including usage/modelUsage/permission fields; Codex CLI 0.144.3 is unsupported and fail-closed as the pinned release's LLM provider; every raw call byte hash is bound in report.json and BrandKit provenance
humanizer_policy.provenance_contract: BrandKit-derived brandkit-provenance.json is regenerated from canonical UTF-8/LF original and result raw bytes, confirmed edits and exact Unicode-codepoint spans; its raw before/after hashes equal manifest, lint and report bindings
